summary: Family-owned beverage and food-base manufacturer operating since 1984 from 5 Connerty Court in East Brunswick, NJ, making granita, juice concentrates, syrups, smoothies, lemonades, teas, soda and bar mixes for restaurants, hotels, casinos, schools, convenience stores and retail shelves, plus private-label production for other brands. Its own labels are Tropical Sensations (juices, drinks, soda, frozen), La Spezzia (coffee syrups) and Evans (ice cream toppings and syrups), and it also exports overseas. Intake appears entirely human-driven: a phone number and email address on a Wix brochure site, with sample requests and private-label conversations handled by phone during weekday office hours.

facts.fact: Founded in 1984 and described as a family owned and operated company that private-labels its products and also sells the Tropical Sensations brand.
Facility address is 5 Connerty Court, East Brunswick, NJ 08816; contact is info@supreme-mfg.com and tel (732) 254-0087.
Office hours Monday-Friday 8:00 am-4:30 pm; warehouse hours Monday-Thursday 8:00 am-4:30 pm and Friday 7:00 am-3:30 pm.

Private-label manufacturing capability: concentrates sweetened with cane sugar, corn sweetener or artificial sweetener; juice/frozen mixes from 5% to 100% juice; packed in bottles or Bag-In-Box; shelf stable at least one year.
Facility is gluten-free and nut-free, with many products offered soy-free, non-dairy, vegan, non-GMO or Fair Trade.

Customer base spans restaurants, hotels, resorts, bars, tiki/beach bars, night clubs, lounges, casinos, Daiquiri shops, school systems, day care facilities, day camps, cafeterias, fitness centers, convenience stores, bodegas, nursing homes, cafes and retail shelves, nationally and globally.
Company says it has the capabilities and requirements to sell to countries around the world and currently sells overseas, both classic formulas and custom flavors.

Catalog is organized into 21 product categories (granita, 100% juice granita, blender mix, bar mixers, drink bases, juice concentrates, slush, soda, lemonade, tea, FCB, smoothies, sno cone, Italian ice, sports drinks, ice cream toppings, coffee syrups, global favorites, 100% juice 7:1 and 5:1, 100% slush).
The public sitemap lists 26 pages and carries a last-modified date of 2025-03-20.
No company careers page exists; the /careers path returns HTTP 404.
No Better Business Bureau profile was found for "Supreme Manufacturing" in East Brunswick, NJ.
SimplyHired returned zero current job listings for Supreme Manufacturing in East Brunswick, NJ.

operations_signals: Order/inquiry intake is phone-and-email only: the contact page publishes a phone number and a single info@ address, with no web form, quote form or online ordering (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-tea-2).

Sample requests and custom-formula inquiries are routed to a phone conversation - the private label page ends with 'Call us today and let's talk', and the about page tells prospects to 'Request a sample' (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-private-label).

No prices, minimum order quantities, case specs or downloadable spec sheets are published anywhere in the product catalog; all 21 categories are flavor tables only, so every quote requires manual staff work (https://www.supremebeverages.com/products).

Published coverage window is weekday business hours only (office closes 4:30 pm, warehouse 3:30 pm Friday); no after-hours, weekend or emergency contact is listed (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-tea-2).

Single location in East Brunswick, NJ with an in-house warehouse operating on its own hours schedule, consistent with local production and shipping rather than distributed plants (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-tea-2).

Service area is explicitly national and international, which implies inbound inquiries across time zones against an East Coast 8-4:30 phone window (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-private-label).
Product pages are static catalog pages with no cart, no account login, no store locator and no distributor/dealer locator (https://www.supremebeverages.com/products).
hiring_signals: No careers or jobs page on the company site - /careers returns HTTP 404 and the 26-page sitemap contains no employment page (https://www.supremebeverages.com/pages-sitemap.xml).
No current postings surfaced on SimplyHired for the company in East Brunswick, NJ (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=Supreme+Manufacturing&l=East+Brunswick%2C+NJ).

Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs and ZipRecruiter could not be read (HTTP 403 bot blocks), so hiring activity there is unverified rather than confirmed absent (https://www.indeed.com/q-supreme-manufacturing-l-east-brunswick,-nj-jobs.html).
review_themes: No public customer reviews were located: BBB shows no profile for the business in East Brunswick (https://www.bbb.org/search?find_text=Supreme%20Manufacturing&find_loc=East%20Brunswick%2C%20NJ).

Google, Yelp and industry review pages were unreachable from this environment (Yelp returned HTTP 403), so no review themes can be honestly summarized (https://www.yelp.com/biz/supreme-manufacturing-co-east-brunswick).

The company's own claims to emphasize in any review work are 'excellent customer service', 'unmatched turn around time' and long-tenured customers of over a decade - self-reported, not third-party verified (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-contact-us).
tech_footprint: Website is built on Wix (page generator meta tag 'Wix.com Website Builder'), with Wix-hosted static media and no custom application layer (https://www.supremebeverages.com/).
No e-commerce, booking, quoting or customer-portal components appear anywhere in the catalog or navigation - the site is a brochure plus catalog (https://www.supremebeverages.com/products).
No live chat, chatbot or contact form widget is published; the only conversion paths are the tel: link and mailto: link (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-tea-2).

No blog, news, recipe, spec-sheet or downloadable PDF content exists in the 26-page sitemap, so there is no published data or content marketing engine (https://www.supremebeverages.com/pages-sitemap.xml).

Site hygiene is DIY-grade: many pages carry auto-generated 'copy-of-' URL slugs (e.g. copy-of-granita-4, copy-of-tea-2) and several product pages are mostly blank separator lines with only a flavor/pack table (https://www.supremebeverages.com/granita).

Two domains serve the same content - supremebeverages.com and supreme-mfg.com - while outbound contact uses a supreme-mfg.com mailbox, suggesting brand/domain drift rather than a managed web presence (https://www.supreme-mfg.com).
growth_signals: Company states its product variety 'is always expanding with new and innovative beverages and trendy flavors', and that it is actively interested in new projects and new products (https://www.supremebeverages.com/).

Portfolio now spans 21 categories, from granita and slush to coffee syrups, sports drinks, Italian ice and 'Global Favorites', indicating line extension beyond the original frozen-beverage base (https://www.supremebeverages.com/products).

Three in-house brands are being carried in parallel - Tropical Sensations, La Spezzia (coffee syrups) and Evans (ice cream toppings/syrups) - which points to expansion into coffee and dessert channels (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-private-label).
Export/international sales are described as current activity, not aspiration, implying growth beyond the NJ/NY metro (https://www.supremebeverages.com/copy-of-contact-us).

Site was still being touched in 2025 (sitemap last modified 2025-03-20), so the web presence is maintained even though copy still references '34 years' in business (https://www.supremebeverages.com/pages-sitemap.xml).
decision_maker: Unknown - no owner, president or GM name is published anywhere on the company website (home, about, private label, contact pages) or in the pages reachable from this environment.

inferences.inference: Inbound demand is likely lost or delayed outside the 8:00-4:30 weekday window, because the only channels are a single phone line and one shared mailbox while the company markets nationally and exports.
inferences.reasoning: Contact page lists just one phone number and one info@ address with weekday-only hours, and the private-label page tells prospects to call; international buyers inquiring outside Eastern time have no async path beyond email.

inferences.inference: Quoting and sample fulfillment are probably the most coordination-heavy manual workflows in the business.
inferences.reasoning: With 21 categories, dozens of flavors and multiple pack formats (bottles, 6x1/2 gallon cases, Bag-In-Box) and zero published pricing, MOQs or spec sheets, every inquiry must be hand-translated into a formulation and price.

inferences.inference: The company is likely a small, owner-operated shop rather than a large plant, based on the absence of any published org chart, careers page or open roles.
inferences.reasoning: No jobs page on a 26-page site, zero listings on the one job board that was readable, a single facility, and marketing copy that emphasizes being family owned and operated; employee count could not be verified from any source.

inferences.inference: Private-label onboarding is a document-heavy, back-and-forth process that would benefit from a structured intake agent.
inferences.reasoning: Buyers must specify sweetener type (cane, corn, artificial, none), juice percentage (5%-100%), pack format (bottle vs Bag-In-Box), and dietary attributes (gluten-free, nut-free, soy-free, vegan, non-GMO, Fair Trade) - all described in prose on the site rather than captured in a form.

inferences.inference: The website itself is a weak lead-capture asset and probably under-reports demand.
inferences.reasoning: Wix template with 'copy-of-' slugs, several half-empty product pages, no forms, no chat, no spec downloads and duplicate content across two domains; there is no mechanism that records or qualifies an inquiry.

inferences.inference: Sales are likely relationship- and phone-driven with a long-tenured repeat base, which makes inbound triage more valuable than new-logo acquisition tooling.
inferences.reasoning: The company states most customers have been with it over a decade, and all its calls to action are 'call us' rather than 'buy online'.
